historical_record.description: Built as the California Memorial Masonic Temple, to house the Masonic Lodge that had been at 25 Van Ness Avenue. One of the last purpose-built clubs and social halls of its kind in the city, put up as fraternal membership peaked after the Second World War.
The Masonic Auditorium, 1958, by Albert F. Roller.
